title: Registry version entry
description: One entry appended to registry/versions.json by stage 12_registry. Entries are append-only: history is never rewritten.

git_commit.description: Commit hash recorded at release time; may be empty when git is unavailable.

prompt_hashes.description: Relative prompt/skill path -> sha256 content hash.

metrics.description: Key metrics of the released run. Numbers only: no wall-clock timestamps.

approval.description: The approval decision bound to the released artifacts, or a short summary string.

previous_version.description: Version this entry supersedes, or null for the first release.

created_at_utc.description: Optional release wall-clock time; registry metadata only.

artifact_hashes.description: Optional sha256 map of the artifacts covered by the release.
